note: Every string the game assembles at runtime (strcpy/strcat chains, sprintf formats, fixed-x pieces on one row), read off the matched C; rendered from the patched build and checked as English by tools/patch/compose_check.py (run by build_patched.py). Piece addresses are retail RAM addresses in the main exe or in the composition's overlay ('ov'). Variables named p_sei / p_mei / p_adana / girl_family / girl_given / girl_full / club / place / digits are read from the build itself (compose_check.builtin_var); the others are listed under 'vars'. 'buf' is the destination buffer in bytes (NUL included): the retail strcat has no bound. 'waive' lists the C files that call strcat/strncat/sprintf but build nothing the player reads as English, with the reason.
